_notes: World metres, Z up, origin on paving under the table centre (data/frame.json; scale fixed by assuming top=0.74 m, the measured 90th-pct top is ~0.75 so the true top sits ~1 cm above that assumption). top_z: 90th pct z of opaque splats at r 0.3-0.75, z>0.735 (+-5 mm). rim_radius: 99.5th pct r of the top band (+-5 mm). plank_thickness: 2-98 pct z spread at the rim edge is ~3.7 cm but includes splat blur; the close_legs reference shows a thin rim band, so the fitted default is 2.8 cm. plank_inner_radius: radial density step in the top band (~0.295). Centre disc: almost no opaque splats - it is a dark glossy slate that reflects the sky (low-opacity pale splats at z~0.751, flush with the planks; the mirrored vase appears as dark splats 0.5-0.72 m below it), so its colour comes from the reference images, not the splats. plank_count/gap_phase: grid search over N=30..55 and phase minimising the mean luminance on candidate gap lines (dark gaps) -> 40 wedge planks, gaps at 6+9k deg; confirmed by eye on the unwrapped polar plot. Legs: 4 square legs (~6 cm) at r~0.54 on the 30/120/210/300 deg axes, standing on the foot beams. Foot: two crossing beams (X) along 30 and 120 deg, ~8 cm wide, ~9 cm tall, ends at +-0.68 m with tapered/rounded ends. The pale discs in the hero/opposite views are ground lights in the paving, not table feet. No bearers are visible under the top in close_legs/low_side, so none are modelled. The X foot has a round (umbrella) hole at the crossing and sled-sloped beam ends (close_legs). Colours (sRGB) sampled from outputs/reference/hero_904.png: planks ~(146,117,89)-(154,128,102), disc ~(82-90,80-90,71-78), legs ~(113,83,57). Shader base colours (wood_rgb_srgb etc.) are albedo values calibrated in Cycles against hero, opposite, close_table and close_legs crops under the fitted lighting.
